steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Set the project title required for publishing.
Configure the project with RFQ only, matching the requested final stage configuration.
Work on the RFQ stage before applying its template and line items.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its quantity to 10.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Verify the delivery location was retained in the pricing sheet.
Confirm the project contains one line item.

args.goal: on the buyer's eRFX project screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", click Done, and stop with the saved project-level terms showing both clauses as mandatory

steps.note: Configure the project-level clauses and mandatory setting, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one QA test vendor, corresponding to Vendor A.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ project.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the first project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the first mandatory clause.
Accept the second mandatory clause.
Submit the vendor's quote at 100 after accepting both clauses.
Verify the vendor portal reports the quote as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer-side event page confirms the vendor bid and T&C acceptance.
